# Medical Recovery
A [bold]medical recovery implant[/bold] brings its carrier's body back to the station. It works once; after it has fired it is spent.
Security Officers and Assistants start with one, and the implanter can be bought from the NanoMed Civilian vending machine.
Every recovery runs the same way: a beacon deploys on the body for 5 seconds, then a fulton balloon carries it to a recovery pad over 10 seconds. Each step is announced to Medical on the radio. The implant is only spent once the balloon goes up. If the body is put in a container before then, the recovery stops and the implant can be used again.
There are three ways to start one:
- [bold]Automatically[/bold] when the carrier dies away from the station map, for example on a shuttle or at an away site. The body goes to a pad on the station. - [bold]Recovery beacon:[/bold] use it in your hand. It locks onto the nearest [italic]dead[/italic] carrier within 90 tiles on the same map. - [bold]Recovery console:[/bold] needs Medical access. It lists every carrier who is [italic]critical or dead[/italic] within 90 tiles on the same map. Press Recover next to a name to bring them to the console's pad. The console shows a progress bar while the beacon deploys and a countdown until they arrive. It links to the first pad on its own grid, so build the pad on the same grid.
